title: Read command with explicit information object address
purpose: Provide a compact, mutation-friendly read command seed covering a distinct system command path with explicit IOA parsing.
expected_behavior: ASDU should be parsed as C_RD_NA_1 using TypeID 102 with a single addressed information object and no trailing command-specific payload bytes.
constraints_preserved: Uses APCI start byte 0x68 with consistent length 0x0e
I-format control field kept minimal and valid-looking
Cause of transmission encoded as request 0x0005 by conservative prior
IOA placeholder encoded as 0x000001 in little-endian order
issue_safety_notes: No issue targeting enabled. Seed is a conservative structural analogue for read-command parser coverage only.
